purpose: Close the gap flagged against the 2026-11-02 evidence: that wheel CLI smoke reused host NumPy/Mido via PYTHONPATH instead of a genuinely independent install, and that real Beat This! checkpoint inference had no attempted/recorded evidence.

constraints_enforced: CLI invoked from a directory outside the repository checkout
no reuse of checkout or host site-packages

installed_wheel_core_workflow.note: Explicit stub beat tracker (source field literally says EXPLICIT-STUB-not-real-beat-this). This exercises WAV decode, DSP transcription, MIDI/JSON export and humanize/groove export on the INSTALLED wheel from outside the checkout. It is NOT real-model evidence and is not represented as such.

ai_extra_install.note: Dependency resolution and installation of the ai extra, in the same strict independent venv as above, is NOT the blocker.

model_identity.license_upstream_weights: MIT (per upstream documentation, and per this repo's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
model_identity.host_source_basis: Read directly from beat_this 1.1.0's own inference.py (CHECKPOINT_URL constant); this is the paper authors' own hosting, not a third-party mirror.

blocker.evidence: curl CONNECT tunnel to cloud.cp.jku.at:443 returns HTTP 403; this session's proxy status endpoint logs {"kind":"connect_rejected","host":"cloud.cp.jku.at:443"}. Reproduced identically via direct curl and via groovemap_next.beat_tracker.BeatThisTracker(checkpoint="final0") -> ValueError("Could not load the checkpoint given the provided name", "final0").
blocker.action_taken: Reported once per the proxy's own guidance ("do not retry or route around it"). No retries, no alternate/unofficial mirror attempted, no synthetic substitute presented as real inference.

real_beat_this_inference.separately_missing: No real, licensed, isolated drum-stem WAV exists anywhere in this sandbox (checked /root/.claude/uploads and filesystem). This is independent of the network blocker above.

not_performed: Genuine Beat This! checkpoint inference on a real drum stem (blocked as above)
